name: 8/13 wa Yomiya Nanoda!
source:
―― "I'll go to tomorrow's festival with you."

Yuuri, a computer spy, approaches Shisaki, who is suspected of being a rebel, as a handyman. How will Yuuri, a spy with a sense of justice, confront Shisaki?

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/7631]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
——“明天的祭典，我陪你去。”

电脑间谍Yuuri以杂工的身份接近被怀疑是反叛者的Shisaki。怀有正义感的Yuuri，将如何面对Shisaki？

[译自 [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/7631]NovelGame[/url]]
